gaps.explanation: The General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p5) itemizes only the General Government departments (County Board ... Miscellaneous; actual sum 3,021,185, all in detail) but its printed TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS is 5,660,526; the other General Fund functions are not itemized on the schedule, so they are missing from detail. The governmental funds statement General Fund column (p4) prints them: Public Safety 2,293,289 + Public Works 43,373 + Public Assistance 36,052 + Capital Outlay 266,627 = 2,639,341 (General Fund Total 5,660,525 = General Government 3,021,184 + 2,639,341). Arithmetic: 9,877,923 + 2,639,341 = 12,517,264 vs statement 12,517,263 (difference 1 = the report's own rounding, schedule General Government 3,021,185 vs statement 3,021,184).
